title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30434: add purchase prepayment amount event
summary: An extensibility event allows purchase prepayment amount calculations to be overridden by extensions, matching the existing sales prepayment extensibility.
key_points: Added OnBeforePrepmtAmount event to codeunit 444 Purchase-Post Prepayments
Event supports overridable result parameter for custom calculation logic
Event propagated across all localization layers (W1, APAC, ES, IT, NA, NL)
Provides parity with existing sales prepayment extensibility
